verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a REST API for syncs, models, sources and destinations, but nothing in the pack mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on all of them. Having a REST API is not the same as publishing a machine-readable spec for it, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
